answer_1.quote: Task-specific Natural Language Generation (NLG) aims to generate texts that satisfy desired attributes of target tasks, such as text style transfer and task-specific data augmentation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated sentences conditioned on task labels (e.g., style‑transfer or augmented classification examples)

answer_2.quote: We use the widely adopted metric ACC avg ... In addition, to measure the diversity of generated examples, we calculate the average similarity scores ... we use BLEU and word mover distance (WMD) as the similarity functions. ... We use three automatic metrics, Style-transfer Accuracy, Self‑WMD and Perplexity, to evaluate the accuracy of style transfer, semantic relevance and naturalness of the generated text.
